There are more inventory related events in dbus-sensors.
https://github.com/openbmc/dbus-sensors/blob/master/src/fan/PresenceGpio.hpp#L30

But I am hunting down what `deviceType` options there are.
1.0.0, right?
Trying to ensure this generates OpenBMC.0.1.InventoryAdded as https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/src/entity_manager.hpp#L149C22-L149C48.
The design for events said we were going to deprecate the old events.  We shouldn't try to map to any of the old "OpenBMC.*" ones.
This will create "OpenBMC_InventoryInventory.0.0.InventoryRemoved" as you currently have it specified.  You might want to move the Inventory.events up a level?
Acknowledged
Acknowledged
Thanks for catching that. I moved it out.

Why is "InventoryRemoved" a warning?  Hardware can often be plugged and unplugged while a BMC is in some state of running, depending on the system design.  I don't think this should be an error.

If we have an error because a _Required_ piece of hardware has been removed, we need to be more explicit on the error defined here.
Yeah, EM always had this as an event. I can bump down the priority of this.
Acknowledged
Technically, EM has both these as events. But I think removed can use a little bump in priority.
Acknowledged

It is concerning to me that we'd be exposing an entity-manager "Type" string that doesn't necessarily correlate to anything documented or anything elsewhere in the system.  How would a daemon like PLDM properly fill one of these in?
Removed all of those and used an object_path instead. That would be more usable across all other inventory types.
How do we decide that these are the set required?  Model vs PN vs SparePart Number... I bet people have differing opinions here.
Removed these in favor of object_path.
There is no resolution?  😄  Wouldn't it be plug it back in?
Acknowledged
Leave off the resolution if you don't need it (or it is "None").
👍 Did not know it was optional.
Acknowledged

@patrick@stwcx.xyz How's the event log allow list/blocklist coming?  If these were put into EM without it, anyone that uses D-Bus event logs would start getting these new ones without a way to ignore them.
FYI, if spam is a concern, this is not super important for me. So, I can hold off implementing it into EM till we have the allowlist for phosphor-logging implemented.
I'll get the allow/block list stuff done this week.
the filter stuff is added. So putting this back in queue.
@spinler@us.ibm.com / @ed@tanous.net - Any concerns?
Isn't the inventory still there, but an entry/item/entity was removed from it?
To be honest I was thinking of those interchangeably. I was using the word inventory as a "hardware entity". Do you prefer alternative wording? Like entity instead of inventory?
Yea, 'An entity' or 'An inventory entity' sounds more correct.
Roger that! Changes coming up.

Based on your commit message

> In order for broad application, the log contains just
the object path since not all inventory information would
be available across all inventory structures/entities.

it's the object path, so maybe rename to `Path` or similar?
Done
An example would be helpful for which string could go here.
If it can be just the name, then we have to use `type: string`, right?
Done
This and the message of InventoryAdded should be updated to follow the metadata name change.
oops. Thanks for catching it! I fixed it.
practical solution which can apply to all inventory items.
